title: User-Facing Usage Documentation
description: Document how to use the kanban board (create boards/columns/cards, drag-and-drop, filtering, persistence behavior) in the README so a new user can operate the app.
spec:
1. README describes creating boards, columns, and cards
2. README describes drag-and-drop reordering and moving cards between columns
3. README describes filtering/search and where data is stored (localStorage, single-user, local-only)
4. README notes the non-empty-column delete rule and the corrupt-state fallback behavior
5. Verify the README reflects the shipped UI (not the stock Vite template)
